title: The BIP Sieve: cohort and portfolio ledger

sampling.method: Purposive descriptive cohort selected for different outcomes and useful compatibility comparisons.
sampling.primary_unit: A design or deployment episode with a specified target and baseline.
limitations: Related BIPs, implementations and activation campaigns share causes.
Open proposals are right-censored at the observation date.
Numbered BIPs omit proposals screened out before publication.
The selected elective hard-fork campaigns cluster around the block-size controversy.
Different networks and emergency repairs have separate outcome criteria.

coding_guide.official_status: Current document metadata at the pinned BIPs revision; Closed can combine several historical closure reasons.
coding_guide.observed_outcome: The evidenced network or campaign event, recorded separately from document status.
coding_guide.right_censored: True when eventual deployment or retirement of the specified open design remains unobserved. A null value marks a new coverage row whose network-event history still needs independent coding.
coding_guide.mixed_lifecycle: MAST members have different lifecycle states; member-level coding is required for any later estimator.
coding_guide.family_id: A grouping aid for related episodes. Additional overlapping lineage links may be needed for statistical work.
coding_guide.interpretation: An analytical inference; sources directly support the facts and attributed statements.
coding_guide.extra_consensus_dependencies: Requirements for the named implementation and security profile, beyond activated baseline rules.
coding_guide.counts: Records describe episodes, controls and related designs. Their count is not an adoption denominator.

episodes.baseline_rules: Existing BIP9 SegWit deployment before lock-in.
episodes.observed_outcome: deployed_activation_intervention
episodes.outcome_evidence: Current BIP is Deployed and defines a 269-of-336 threshold plus mandatory existing bit 1 signaling.
episodes.coding_note: Related to successful SegWit episode; text alone does not identify its marginal causal effect.
episodes.interpretation: Reusing already shipped deployment machinery can reduce coordination and testing costs.

episodes.baseline_rules: Existing BIP9 SegWit deployment before lock-in.
episodes.observed_outcome: deployed_activation_intervention
episodes.outcome_evidence: Current BIP is Deployed and specifies an August 1 2017 flag day until SegWit lock-in.
episodes.coding_note: Author hoped miners would activate early; distinguish intended pressure from proved causality.

episodes.baseline_rules: Post-SegWit mainnet rules with undefined witness version 1.
episodes.observed_outcome: mainnet_deployed
episodes.outcome_evidence: BIP 341 records actual activation 709632; Core 0.21.1 specifies Speedy Trial 90% signaling and minimum height.
episodes.coding_note: 340 specifies cryptography and has no Layer field; 341/342 are consensus carriers.
episodes.interpretation: The design explicitly balanced scope and integrated benefits; deployment process remained a separate negotiation.

episodes.baseline_rules: Existing Taproot deployment before lock-in.
episodes.observed_outcome: closed_after_feature_deployed_by_other_route
episodes.outcome_evidence: June 1 2026 changelog closes it because no longer relevant and no known deployments.
episodes.coding_note: Successful target feature; unused/retired mechanism. Do not code as rejected Taproot.
episodes.interpretation: A proposal document can close while its desired capability succeeds.

episodes.baseline_rules: Bitcoin 0.7 and 0.8 diverged over a database-dependent block constraint; the episode contains several transitions.
episodes.observed_outcome: canonical_chain_restored_and_upgrade_deadline_imposed
episodes.outcome_evidence: BIP 50 describes emergency mining rollback; 0.8.1 temporary restriction March 21–May15 and official May 15 deadline.
episodes.coding_note: Control outside ordinary planned proposals; BIP 50 is an Informational postmortem.
episodes.interpretation: Shared emergency danger changes coordination incentives and complicates a single SF/HF label.

episodes.baseline_rules: Fixed actual shared chain versus sufficiently deep hypothetical alternate histories.
episodes.observed_outcome: deployed_implementation_simplification
episodes.outcome_evidence: Text explicitly discusses incompatible judgments on sufficiently deep alternate histories.
episodes.coding_note: Informational control outside planned capability cohorts.
episodes.interpretation: Set-inclusion definitions need a fixed baseline and relevant shared-history domain.

episodes.baseline_rules: Contemporaneous 1,000,000-byte base-block limit and associated validation rules
episodes.observed_outcome: Proposed capacity rules did not become Bitcoin mainnet consensus
documented_concerns: BIP101 discusses full-node cost, propagation advantage and mining concentration, plus UTXO growth.
BIP102 explicitly says old validating clients reject blocks above the old bound.
BIP109 supplies a signature-hashing cap and accurate sigop counting to address CPU exhaustion, and defines withdrawal on missing its deadline.
episodes.interpretation: These are correlated proposals from one controversy. Their outcomes confound fork incompatibility with capacity policy and resource distribution; they cannot identify an independent HF penalty.

episodes.baseline_rules: Post-SegWit Bitcoin; phase two proposed a base-block capacity increase
episodes.observed_outcome: Organizers suspended the forthcoming 2MB hard fork
documented_concerns: Organizers stated that sufficient consensus for a coordinated upgrade had not formed and that proceeding risked dividing the community.
episodes.interpretation: Record the group's decision and stated reason. Its attribution of SegWit activation to SegWit2x is a participant claim, not established causal history.
episodes.source_provenance: The original mailing-list endpoint was unavailable. The cited contemporaneous full copy preserves the author, timestamp and signatories.

episodes.baseline_rules: Pre-split Bitcoin rules with 1MB base-block bound
episodes.observed_outcome: A continuing separate chain was launched
documented_concerns: UAHF specification requires its first fork block to exceed 1MB to enforce separation.
The specification supplies replay-protected signatures and an emergency difficulty adjustment to support the independent chain.
episodes.interpretation: Successful separate-chain launch is a distinct outcome from coordinated Bitcoin-mainnet deployment. The first-party history records the split; the contemporaneous technical spec establishes intentional incompatibility.

episodes.baseline_rules: BIP114 depends on SegWit; BIP116/117 propose opcode/final-stack restrictions
episodes.observed_outcome: Exact designs remain undeployed in inspected Core; BIP114 closed while BIP116/117 remain Draft; Taproot acknowledges earlier Merkle-branch work
documented_concerns: BIP117 explains the restriction to one tail-call layer and its resource bounds.
BIP117 authors sought deployment independent of resolving the complete package for a new witness version.
episodes.interpretation: Record acknowledged conceptual contribution to Taproot as a lineage edge, not a fabricated formal replacement of all earlier BIPs.
episodes.coding_note: Mixed lifecycle bundle: BIP114 is terminal as a document, BIP116/117 remain right-censored. Store member-level statuses if doing statistical work.

episodes.baseline_rules: BIP342 unknown Tapscript public-key types
episodes.observed_outcome: Specification remains open; candidate semantics absent from inspected Core
documented_concerns: Current design confines opt-in to tapscript paths and discusses unsafe rebinding and mitigation with relative timelocks.
episodes.interpretation: An application can motivate a narrow signature-hash extension while rebinding semantics still require careful review. Count NOINPUT and APO as a design lineage.

episodes.baseline_rules: OP_NOP4 upgrade slot
episodes.observed_outcome: Specification remains open; activation logic omitted from BIP; OP_NOP4 retained as NOP in inspected Core
documented_concerns: Variable-length transaction components must be cached to avoid repeated quadratic hashing work.
Exact template commitments constrain flexibility and multiple-input designs expose half-spend concerns.
The BIP describes finite nested template paths under hash assumptions.
episodes.interpretation: Distinguish design, activation campaign, and application outcome. CTV supplies no basis for a halting-problem criticism.

episodes.baseline_rules: Tapscript OP_SUCCESS126
episodes.observed_outcome: Specification complete; OP_SUCCESS behavior remains in inspected Core
documented_concerns: The proposal keeps the 520-byte stack-item limit and leaves legacy-script OP_CAT disabled.
Authors explicitly separate the concatenation proposal from any increase to stack-item size.
episodes.interpretation: Complete describes document maturity. Compatibility depends on the chosen script context; restoring a disabled legacy opcode would alter the fork analysis.

episodes.baseline_rules: Tapscript OP_SUCCESS204
episodes.observed_outcome: Specification remains open; deployment TBD; OP_SUCCESS behavior retained in inspected Core
documented_concerns: Signature verification is charged to the Tapscript sigops budget.
The document compares CTV+CSFS and APO packages for Lightning Symmetry and identifies associated data-availability choices.
episodes.interpretation: Evaluate primitive packages, because combinations can recover overlapping capabilities with different dependency and review costs.

episodes.baseline_rules: Currently undefined witness version 2
episodes.observed_outcome: Specification remains open at version 0.12.1; witness-v2 semantics absent from inspected Core
documented_concerns: The proposal removes the key path to address long-exposure attacks on exposed elliptic-curve keys.
It explicitly separates short-exposure protections and coin-burning proposals from this scope.
episodes.interpretation: State the threat model and migration scope accurately; script-only outputs also provide a useful dependency for genuinely key-path-free application designs.

episodes.baseline_rules: Currently unassigned Taproot leaf version 0xc2.
episodes.observed_outcome: Draft metering framework and future-leaf proposal; corresponding activation is unobserved at the cutoff.
episodes.coding_note: BIP441 requires BIP440. BIP440 alone provides a cost framework; the future leaf carries the expanded execution semantics.

episodes.baseline_rules: Tapscript OP_SUCCESS206.
episodes.observed_outcome: Draft template-hash primitive; relevant extension remains permissive in inspected Core.
episodes.coding_note: A component of BIP448 and an independent dependency in the documented sibling graph.

episodes.baseline_rules: Tapscript extension slots used by BIP446, BIP348 and BIP349.
episodes.observed_outcome: Draft bundle with deployment parameters to be determined.
episodes.coding_note: BIP448 names 446/348/349 as its package. Its component rows are correlated and must share a family in any later statistical study.

episodes.baseline_rules: Transaction relay and local mempool policy.
episodes.observed_outcome: BIP metadata records Deployed for the specified opt-in replacement policy.
episodes.coding_note: Applications layer. This record does not assert that every current node uses this historical policy unchanged.

episodes.baseline_rules: Peer-to-peer transport.
episodes.observed_outcome: BIP metadata records Deployed for version-2 encrypted transport.
episodes.coding_note: Peer Services layer; excluded from SF/HF deployment outcomes.
